evidence_refs_check.detail: All evidence_refs across fields resolve to pack source_ids; no citation of failed source S019; no citation of unknown ids

field_citation_check.detail: Every PROPOSED factual field (fix_type, strategy, target_version, artifact_source, source_identifier, notes) carries non-empty evidence_refs; ABSTAINED command/validation_command carry empty refs with null values; NOT_APPLICABLE build_system carries null with empty refs

forbidden_fields_check.detail: No forbidden top-level or field keys present; fields limited to the nine permitted keys

gate_compliance_check.detail: Pack gates command=INSUFFICIENT and validation_command=INSUFFICIENT honored: both fields null ABSTAINED with typed reason codes and no executable text in any string field

hash_method: proposal_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical proposal bytes (json.dumps sort_keys=True indent=2 plus trailing newline) with the proposal_sha256 field normalized to empty string; proposal_file_sha256_observed is SHA-256 of the exact frozen file bytes on disk

schema_conformance_check.detail: Required top-level keys present; field objects carry value/status/evidence_refs/confidence/reason_summary with permitted status values
